verdict: Organic engagement is your only active signal; paid channels remain off.
narrative: Across all three entities — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — paid advertising recorded zero spend and zero leads over the last 28 days, so every measurable action this period came from Google Business Profile. Combined, your three listings produced 403 total GBP actions (25 calls, 278 direction requests, and 100 web clicks), which represents real local interest but without a paid layer to capture it. Two of the three locations saw GBP engagement soften week-over-week — Forte Metals down 57.69% and O'Hare Precision down 42.55% — while Advance Grinding edged up 16.67%, though the most recent days there have gone quiet. CRM setup milestones that were due in July remain open across all entities, and closing those is the priority work underway now so that outreach sequences and pipeline tracking can go live on schedule.
